title: 第一卷 第49章 太上长老冷雨秋第一卷 第48章 名额
lines: 朱白石走后，秦绝忽然想起了凤白芷。
之前凤白芷口中的大机缘，多半指的也是云山秘境了。
同样是一个名额，三方各有态度。
然而，他们却不知道，秦绝对这云山秘境，其实并没有那么稀罕。
不过既然大嫂赵清梦要进云山秘境，他便跟着去走一遭，既可以收获一些天材地宝，也能照应点赵清梦。
毕竟那云山秘境，除了机缘，更有凶险。
嘭！
灵山宗内，一个茶盏，在冷玄霆的掌心里，嘭然炸裂！
“你说什么？素云宗和玄元宗都没同意？”冷玄霆看着拜访回来的二长老苏有谋，脸色难看至极。
苏有谋苏有谋叹声道：“是的，这二宗，都不同意与我宗结盟。二宗如此果决，必是有其他算计。宗主，眼下这局势，是愈发不妙了啊。”
冷玄霆紧握着一手碎片，咬牙怒笑道：“怎么，难道那小子还敢杀上我灵山宗不成？他真当我灵山宗是泥捏的不成！”
苏有谋脸皮微抽。
在那秦绝的刀下，灵山宗可不就是泥捏的？
否则，八大长老、九头异兽，岂会全留在了凤州城？
“宗主，我们该认清情况了。我宗既然得不到外援，那便不再适合向秦绝寻仇了，反而，该试着去和他缓和一下关系。否则，真等秦绝提刀杀上宗门，我宗定是挡不住的。”苏有谋躬身抱拳，言辞间，带着几分恳求。
宗门之辱，亦是他心中之辱。
若是一般人，哪怕只是伤了灵山宗的弟子，灵山宗也绝不会忍上一口窝囊气！
可如今，形势不利，是他们不如人，不忍这口窝囊气，最终的下场，很可能就是宗灭人亡！
“呵呵呵呵……二长老，你可真是个人才！那秦绝杀了你我同门师兄弟八人，你竟然还想着和他缓和关系！这口窝囊气，要受你自己受着！即便没有外援，本宗也会与他不死不休！”冷玄霆气怒着吼道。
死在秦绝手下的，可不仅仅是八大长老啊，还有他的儿子！
杀子之仇，岂能不报！
苏有谋抬起头来，眼眶发红道：“宗主，事不可为，不可硬为啊！否则，会害了整个宗门啊。”
“住嘴！本宗绝对不可能去向一个小辈认怂！你可以滚回去了！”冷玄霆怒吼一声。
苏有谋轻叹一声，转身离去。
殿外。
一道人影，飞身而来。
苏有谋眼眸一颤，连忙迎了上去。
“大长老，你那边结果如何？”苏有谋急忙问道。
回来的人，正是前往凤家和清河宗的大长老余成。
余成无奈摇头道：“清河宗无意对秦绝出手，凤家的态度也是模棱两可，并不靠谱。你那边情况如何？”
苏有谋轻叹道：“都没成。那小子手段太狠，杀人太疯，直接将玄元宗和素云宗都吓怕了，根本不敢卷入进来。”
余成低沉道：“其实，倘若是我，我也不会卷入……”
苏有谋苦笑不已，换他也是一样啊。那秦绝不是一般的狠，更不是一般的强，除非是脑子有包，否则这种时候，谁愿意主动去招惹秦绝……
只不过这些话，作为灵山宗的长老，他们不该说，只能在心里想。
“宗主仍要报仇，大长老进去劝劝吧。如果连大长老你都劝不住，我们就只能去请太上长老出关了。否则，任由宗主一意孤行，只怕我灵山宗当真要灭亡了。”苏有谋道。
余成沉声道：“你劝不住，我定然也劝不住。谁让这灵山宗，到底是姓冷呢！”
content_en:
After Zhu Baishi left, Qin Jue suddenly thought of Feng Baizhi.
The great opportunity that Feng Baizhi mentioned before was probably referring to the Yunshan Secret Realm.
There is also a quota, and the three parties have their own attitudes.
However, they didn't know that Qin Jue's secret place in Yunshan was actually not that rare.
But since his sister-in-law Zhao Qingmeng is going to the secret realm of Yunshan, he will go with her, not only to harvest some natural treasures, but also to take care of Zhao Qingmeng.
After all, in addition to opportunities, the Yunshan secret realm is also more dangerous.
…
Bang!
In Lingshan Sect, a tea cup exploded in the palm of Leng Xuanting's hand!
"What are you talking about? Neither Suyun Sect nor Xuanyuan Sect agree?" Leng Xuanting looked at the second elder Su Youmou who had returned from a visit, his expression extremely ugly.
Su Youmou Su Youmou sighed: "Yes, these two sects do not agree to form an alliance with our sect. If the two sects are so decisive, they must have other plans. Sect Master, the situation is getting worse and worse now."
Leng Xuanting held the fragments in his hand tightly, gritted his teeth and laughed angrily: "Why, does that kid still dare to kill our Lingshan Sect? He really thinks that our Lingshan Sect is made of mud!"
Su Youmou's face twitched slightly.
Under Qin Jue's sword, wasn't the Lingshan Sect just made of clay?
Otherwise, how could all the eight elders and nine-headed beasts stay in Fengzhou City?
"Sect Master, it's time for us to recognize the situation. Since our sect cannot get any external help, it is no longer suitable to seek revenge on Qin Jue. Instead, we should try to ease the relationship with him. Otherwise, when Qin Jue raises his sword and kills the sect, our sect will not be able to stop it." Su Youmou bowed and clasped his fists, with a hint of pleading in his words.
The sect's humiliation was also a humiliation in his heart.
If it were an ordinary person, even if he only hurt a disciple of Lingshan Sect, Lingshan Sect would never bear the anger of being a coward!
But now, the situation is unfavorable, because they are inferior to others, and if they can't bear this cowardice, the final outcome will probably be the death of their clan and their people!
"Hehehehe... Second Elder, you are really a talent! Then Qin Jue killed eight of you and my fellow disciples, and you still want to ease the relationship with him! You have to bear this cowardice! Even if there is no external help, our sect will fight him to the death!" Leng Xuanting roared angrily.
It was not just the eight elders who died at the hands of Qin Jue, but also his son!
How can we not avenge the murder of our son?
Su Youmou raised his head, his eyes were red and said: "Sect Master, you can't do anything, don't do it forcefully! Otherwise, the entire sect will be harmed."
"Shut up! It is absolutely impossible for our sect to give in to a junior! You can go back!" Leng Xuanting roared angrily.
Su Youmou sighed softly, turned and left.
Outside the palace.
A figure flew over.
Su Youmou's eyes trembled and he rushed forward to greet him.
"Great Elder, what's the result on your side?" Su Youmou asked hurriedly.
The person who came back was Yu Cheng, the great elder who went to the Feng family and Qinghe Sect.
Yu Cheng shook his head helplessly and said: "Qinghe Sect has no intention of taking action against Qin Jue, and the Feng family's attitude is also ambiguous and unreliable. How is the situation over there?"
Su Youmou sighed softly: "It didn't work. That boy was too ruthless and so crazy in killing people. He frightened both the Xuanyuan Sect and the Suyun Sect, and they didn't dare to get involved at all."
Yu Cheng said in a low voice: "Actually, if it were me, I wouldn't get involved..."
Su Youmou smiled bitterly. It would have been the same for him. Qin is by no means ruthless, let alone strong. Unless someone is crazy, who would be willing to take the initiative to provoke Qin Jue at this time...
But as the elders of Lingshan Sect, they should not say these words, they can only think in their hearts.
"The sect master still wants to take revenge. The great elder should go in and persuade him. If you can't persuade the eldest elder, we will have to ask the supreme elder to come out. Otherwise, if the sect master is allowed to have his own way, I am afraid that our Lingshan sect will really perish." Su Youmou said.
Yu Cheng said in a deep voice: "If you can't persuade me, I certainly can't persuade you either. Who knows that this Lingshan Sect's surname is Leng?"
